method: Chromium headless with Apple Metal, 1100x740, render scale 0.7, shadows disabled. Production Friends arena; authored staging terrain and camera settle for 10 seconds before placement. Build through authoritative friendsBuild. Before uses HEAD versions of only the three changed rendering modules via Vite baseline fixtures; after uses working tree. Timed WebGL calls tagged by current renderBufferDirect object. Placement window: first 1200ms. Ordinary background shader warmup calls are reported separately (object=null).

camera drag orbits left/right and tilts up/down; capture outside, mouse release, blur, reset, and toolbar controls work without moving the crane
mast and arm extend together with a connected load; releasing outside a button brakes only that axis
menu turns the prefab smoothly and the actual connected load swings on its cable
anti-sway switches through the actual menu
precision speed switches through the actual menu
real host motors reach a 256m mast and 256m arm with world collision checks enabled
Escape brakes all axes on the fully extended crane

limits: Single controlled before/after pair; device timings vary. An unrelated background warmup query still occurs after placement. This change addresses crane first-use shader stalls, not all world streaming or background compilation.
